camel_example: aliyun ossutil api get-bucket-replication-location --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Retrieves the regions to which a source bucket can be replicated. You can use the response to determine the destination region for data replication from the source bucket
description_zh: 获取可复制到的目标存储空间（Bucket）所在的地域。您可以根据返回结果决定将源Bucket的数据复制到哪个地域
name: GetBucketReplicationLocation
